title: Kernel, surjectivity and compatibility of the standard p-adic reduction homomorphisms
statement: Let $p$ be prime and let $\mathbf Z_p$ be the ring of $p$-adic integers [def-weil-l-adic-numbers]. For $n\ge0$, let $q_n:\mathbf Z_p\to\mathbf Z/p^n\mathbf Z$ be the standard reduction ring homomorphism, namely $\operatorname{PadicInt.toZModPow}(n)$. Then $q_n$ is surjective and $\ker(q_n)=(p^n)$. For every $m\le n$, the standard residue reduction $r_{n,m}:\mathbf Z/p^n\mathbf Z\to\mathbf Z/p^m\mathbf Z$ satisfies $r_{n,m}\circ q_n=q_m$. These statements include $n=0$, where $\mathbf Z/p^0\mathbf Z$ is the zero ring.
